title: RL Infra Engineer - Varsapura
description:
HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content.

Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community.

Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies.

In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.

When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.

What You Will Do:

You will build and own the infrastructure foundation of our reinforcement learning framework, enabling RL-driven gameplay systems that can scale across current and future UE5 projects. This is a hands-on, hybrid role that sits between ML research and game/engine engineering. The focus is on turning research ideas into robust, deployable, production-ready systems that run inside real game environments.

You will:

•
Collaborate with the gameplay team to deliver machine learning and Al solutions that enhance the game experience on Varsapura, our upcoming flagship title.

•
Partner closely with gameplay engineers to prototype, optimize, and productionize reinforcement learning pipelines.

•
Take ownership of the technical roadmap for RL infrastructure, identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements in reliability, scalability, and iteration speed.

•
Deploy and operate learning agents in live or simulated UE-based environments, and optimize infrastructure for runtime inference.

What We Are Looking For:

•
8+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning, or related technical roles.

•
Strong proficiency with Python and C++.

•
Experience with game development workflows, including debugging, profiling, and version control.

•
Solid understanding of deep neural network architectures and reinforcement learning concepts.

•
Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as Pytouch, Tensorflow.

•
Experience with distributed machine learning systems on cloud infrastructure.

•
Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning applications in production environments.

Pluses:

•
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field

•
Experience with end-to-end RL workflows, from training to production deployment.

•
Experience working with Unreal Engine.

•
Experience with cross-functional collaboration in fast-moving engineering environments

Benefits:

The base pay range for this position is $200,000 to $300,000 USD per year. Actual pay is based on location and may vary depending on relevant knowledge, skills, and experience from the candidate. Total compensation may include salary, company bonuses, sign-on bonuses, relocation package, and other benefits such as:

•
100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you and your dependents

•
Generous paid time off

•
401K / RRSP plan

•
Employer-paid life and disability insurance

•
Team-building activities throughout the year

•
Flexible working hours

We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

description:

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Procurement

• Lead strategic sourcing for GPU systems, CPUs, high-speed networking (InfiniBand NDR/XDR, 400G/800G Ethernet), and high-performance storage

• Manage relationships with OEMs, ODMs, and system integrators; structure framework agreements and multi-year supply commitments

• Drive RFP/RFQ processes, vendor scorecards, and competitive bidding across hardware categories

• Manage allocation negotiations during constrained supply periods and secure priority access during product launches

• Oversee logistics, lead-time management, staging, and burn-in coordination across global supply chains

• Navigate export controls, and cross-border compliance, particularly for advanced compute hardware

Data Center Sourcing

• Source and negotiate colocation, build-to-suit, and powered shell agreements with hyperscale, wholesale, and regional data center operators

• Evaluate facility specifications: power density (kW/rack), cooling architectures (air, liquid, direct-to-chip, immersion), redundancy tiers (N+1, 2N), PUE, WUE, and sustainability commitments

• Assess site selection factors: latency, fiber connectivity, power reliability, climate, regulatory environment, and expansion optionality

• Negotiate commercial terms covering power pricing, escalators, SLAs, remote hands, cross-connects, and exit clauses

• Build TCO models across capex, power, cooling, networking, real estate, and operational costs over multi-year horizons

Required Qualifications

• 3–5 years of procurement or supply chain experience, with exposure to AI infrastructure or advanced compute hardware categories preferred

• Demonstrated track record negotiating and closing multi-million to nine-figure hardware and data center deals

• Demonstrated expertise in data center fundamentals: power delivery (utility, UPS, PDU, busway), cooling systems, structural and electrical capacity planning, and tier classifications

• Experience with acceptance testing, validation workflows, and commercial enforcement of technical SLAs

• Proficiency in TCO modeling, scenario analysis, and financial structuring of infrastructure deals

• Excellent commercial judgment and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate fluently between engineering, finance, and vendor stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience procuring across multiple geographies

• Established network within the AI hardware ecosystem (NVIDIA, hyperscalers, neoclouds, leading OEM/ODMs)

• Background in engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a quantitative field

Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community.

Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies.

In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.

When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.

Responsibilities

Creative localization and English quality
-Serve as a senior English quality owner across assigned titles and workstreams, setting editorial standards and making defensible final recommendations.
-Translate, edit, and rewrite complex or high-impact Simplified Chinese content into polished English that recreates the intended meaning, tone, emotion, characterization, humor, rhythm, and gameplay clarity.
-Challenge literal, obvious, or inherited solutions when they do not work in English; explore alternatives, make bold but defensible decisions, and turn ambiguity or implementation constraints into better player-facing solutions.

Terminology, style, and narrative voice
-Develop and maintain terminology databases, style guides, character voice profiles, naming conventions, translation memories, and other linguistic assets that teams can apply consistently.
-Resolve terminology and style conflicts, document decisions and exceptions, and work with narrative, IP, design, and publishing stakeholders to preserve characterization, worldbuilding, tone, and gameplay meaning.

Review, mentorship, and leadership
-Review work produced by internal linguists and external partners, providing precise, actionable feedback that strengthens both the immediate text and future performance.
-Mentor and develop other linguists through feedback, quality calibrations, review discussions, onboarding support, and knowledge-sharing sessions that turn individual judgment into repeatable team standards.
-Where experience and department needs align, take on people management or broader discipline leadership, including goal-setting, capability building, and team development.

LQA and cross-functional delivery
Conduct in-game LQA across development and live-service builds, identifying, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, and verifying linguistic, functional, visual, and contextual issues.
Account for variables, tags, markup, character limits, input prompts, text layout, platform conventions, and runtime context; partner with relevant teams to diagnose root causes, close issues, and prevent recurrence.

Department-wide improvement
-Lead or contribute to cross-project initiatives involving quality frameworks, reviewer calibration, terminology governance, vendor quality, localization workflows, tooling, automated checks, localization readiness, and knowledge sharing.
-Look beyond established processes, analyze recurring quality problems, and propose inventive but practical improvements to source content, production workflows, linguistic assets, or localization systems.
-Help evaluate CAT, TMS, QA, automation, and AI-assisted tools with a focus on quality, security, and fit for purpose; represent English localization in cross-functional discussions and advocate for its requirements early in development.

What we are looking for

Native English speaker with exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and professional-level editorial judgment.
Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese, including the ability to interpret nuanced source text and discuss linguistic or creative issues directly with Chinese-speaking stakeholders.
At least five years of professional game-localization experience, including substantial Chinese-to-English translation, editing, or linguistic-quality ownership.
Hands-on experience shipping and supporting at least one major, globally released live-service title, including recurring updates and long-term terminology or narrative continuity.
Demonstrated ability to edit across narrative, dialogue, gameplay, UI, system-oriented, and terminology-heavy content.
Strong in-game LQA experience, including severity assessment, clear issue reporting, stakeholder follow-through, and final verification.
Practical expertise with CAT tools, translation-management systems, terminology databases, translation memories, linguistic QA tools, and spreadsheet-based workflows.
Experience reviewing other linguists' work and delivering constructive feedback that improves quality and consistency.
Creative and intellectually curious, with a deep commitment to recreating the original player experience in English; willing to question obvious or inherited solutions and defend stronger alternatives.
Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to explain editorial decisions to both linguistic and non-linguistic partners.
Currently based in Shanghai or willing and able to relocate to Shanghai.

Preferred qualifications

Experience developing talent, or owning language quality across multiple projects.
Experience working across multiple game projects, ideally in China or with Chinese game-development organizations.
Experience creating or improving language-quality frameworks, review rubrics, reviewer-calibration practices, terminology systems, or vendor evaluation standards.
Familiarity with localization engineering, regular expressions, automated QA, scripting, structured text, or localization data analysis.

We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

Responsibilities

•
Provide language support for HoYoverse titles across multiple markets, covering game and manga localization as well as day-to-day live operations.

•
Conduct localization testing to ensure the quality and accuracy of localized content as presented in-game.

•
Coordinate communication within the team and across departments; collect, document, report, and follow up on localization-related issues to ensure they are resolved.

•
Monitor player issues and feedback, and help improve the game based on an understanding of local language and culture.

•
Support the planning and execution of online and offline game events, and contribute to game community development.

•
Develop creative concepts and produce content for various marketing and promotional initiatives.

Requirements

•
Fluent in Turkish and Simplified Chinese. Native proficiency in either or both languages is a plus. Able to handle Chinese-to-Turkish localization, including translation, proofreading, MTPE (machine translation post-editing), and LQA (linguistic quality assurance) for in-game and out-of-game content. Project management experience is a plus.

•
Bachelor's degree or above.

•
Passionate about anime, manga, and gaming culture, with extensive gaming experience and a strong understanding of the writing styles and conventions of different game genres. Familiarity with and enthusiasm for HoYoverse titles is a plus.

•
Familiar with local players, particularly the preferences and behaviors of anime and manga fans.

•
Creative and full of ideas, with the ability to develop and produce engaging content for various game marketing and promotional initiatives.

•
Excellent information research, extraction, and synthesis skills, as well as the ability to learn new things quickly.

Strong teamwork, communication, and execution skills. Detail-oriented, responsible, and highly self-motivated.

title: Test Development Engineer -Entry Level
Test Development Engineer (Payments)
description:
HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content.

Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies.

In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.

When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.

What you'll do

•
Own quality assurance for payment and web top-up services. Participate in requirements and technical design reviews, identify risks through code, configuration and past issues, and define test strategies and assess quality.

•
Drive test delivery in collaboration with AI agents, covering functional, performance and stability testing. Verify results, close coverage gaps, drive issue resolution and take responsibility for quality conclusions.

•
Build agent-driven integration validation and load-testing pipelines for new games and payment channels. Connect configuration checks, test data preparation and end-to-end validation; orchestrate load-test scenarios, execution and metrics analysis to build reusable capabilities.

•
Develop agent skills, tools and automation frameworks, improving knowledge integration, task orchestration, result validation and failure handling to increase test coverage, accuracy and efficiency.

•
Take ownership of cross-team delivery, coordinating with product, engineering, operations and third-party teams to resolve collaboration blockers, improve workflows and increase delivery efficiency.

What we're looking for

•
Bachelor's degree or above with 2–5 years of testing or test-development experience;

•
Experience testing payments, transactions, e-commerce or fintech preferred, with a solid understanding of payment flows and common failure scenarios;

•
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java or Go) and the ability to build test scripts or tools independently;

•
Solid knowledge of operating systems and networking, comfortable with databases (MySQL, MongoDB) and logs for independent issue investigation and data verification;

•
Hands-on performance and load testing experience (JMeter, Locust or in-house platforms) and familiarity with capacity evaluation methodologies;

•
A user-centric mindset: able to understand what players really expect in the payment flow and how failures feel to them, and to prioritise issues accordingly;

•
Hands-on practice with AI agents or LLMs in testing: able to write skills, scripts and tools to extend agent capabilities, or a strong drive for test orchestration and automation;

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and advanced Chinese, to liaise with teams and review internal documentation;

•
Proactive, able to drive issues to closure and collaborate across teams.

Nice to have: passion for games; multi-currency and risk & compliance experience; Kubernetes-related testing experience; experience building test pipelines or agent capabilities from scratch.
